::: {#hero-heading}
Thanks for stopping by!

I’m a Data Scientist Intern at <a href="https://www.metrotransit.org/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Metro Transit (Metropolitan Council)</a>.  
My interests include **causal inference**, **geospatial analysis**, and **transit analytics**. I like building clean, reproducible pipelines in R/Python and turning them into useful visualizations and apps.

Want the longer story? Check out my [projects](projects.qmd) and [visualizations](visuals.qmd)—or grab my [resume](images/batsaikhan_resume%20copy.pdf).
:::


## About me

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6}
**Stats major with a focus on data for public good.**

I work mostly in **R** (tidyverse, sf, Shiny) and **SQL**, with growing **Python** usage. I care about explainability, data ethics, and shipping tools that real people actually use. You’ll often find me iterating in Quarto and Shiny.

<ul class="fa-ul">
  <li><span class="fa-li"><i class="fa-solid fa-bus"></i></span>Transit analytics & GTFS/RT data pipelines</li>
  <li><span class="fa-li"><i class="fa-solid fa-tree"></i></span>Urban climate & environmental equity (LST, tree canopy, SVI)</li>
  <li><span class="fa-li"><i class="fa-solid fa-diagram-project"></i></span>Causal graphs, matching, and sensitivity analysis</li>
</ul>
:::

::: {.g-col-6}
Before Metro Transit, I researched environmental inequality in Minneapolis, combining historical housing data with modern climate and health indicators. I enjoy mapping, teaching stats concepts, and building dashboards that make complex analyses easy to explore.

<ul class="fa-ul">
  <li><span class="fa-li"><i class="fa-solid fa-graduation-cap"></i></span>BA in Statistics (Math minor) — Macalester College</li>
  <li><span class="fa-li"><i class="fa-solid fa-person-chalkboard"></i></span>Teaching Assistant: Probability & Data Science</li>
  <li><span class="fa-li"><i class="fa-solid fa-trophy"></i></span>Captain, Men’s Swimming & Diving (leadership & teamwork)</li>
</ul>
:::
